source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the quantum theory of radiation (PDF 119).

blocks.text: 1901 mein Max Planck ne tajweez kiya ke tawanai musalsal lehar ke bajaye alag alag packets mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai jinhein quanta (wahid: quantum) kehte hain. Har quantum aik frequency ki shua se talluq rakhta hai, aur us ki tawanai E us ki frequency f ke mutanasib hai: E = hf (18.1), jahan h Planck constant, 6.63 x 10^-34 J s, hai. Planck ko tawanai ke quanta ki daryaft par 1918 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Planck constant h quantum theory ka bunyadi constant hai; aik aur ahem constant, roshni ki raftar c, special theory of relativity ka constant hai.

Planck ne tajweez kiya ke jaise maddah bohat se nanhe zarrat se bana hai, garam source ki shuai tawanai bhi daanedar hai, aur unhon ne farz kiya ke yeh use paida karne wale atoms ki kisi khasiyat ki wajah se hai. Einstein ne yeh khayal aage barhaya: tawanai ke packets tamam electromagnetic shuaon ka lazmi hissa hain aur mazeed taqseem nahi ho sakte. Unhon ne in na-qabil-e-taqseem tawanai ke bundlon ko photons kaha. Wavelength lambda ki roshni ki shua c raftar se chalte photons ki dhaar hai, har aik E = hf tawanai rakhta hai.

Relativity ki theory se E = mc^2, aur photon ka momentum p = mc, is liye E = pc (18.2). Phir pc = hf, is liye p = hf/c, aur kyunke c = f lambda, photon ka momentum p = h/lambda (18.3). Kyunke photon momentum rakhta hai, roshni jis satah par pare us par quwwat (radiation pressure) laga sakti hai.

Quantum theory har nizam par phailayi ja sakti hai, jaise spring par jhoolti kamiyat, lekin wahan tawanai ke qadam itne chhote hain ke pakre nahi ja sakte, is liye zarrati fitrat nazar nahi aati. Quantum asraat sirf atom jitni cheezon ke liye ahem hain, jahan tawanai ki har qabil-e-mushahida tabdeeli mein h numayan hai.

blocks.prompt: 600 nm wavelength wale photon ki tawanai aur momentum maloom karein.

items: Planck (1901): tawanai quanta mein, E = hf, h = 6.63 x 10^-34 J s.
Photon ka momentum p = E/c = h/lambda; roshni quwwat laga sakti.
